options_save_failed.message: Hindi maaaring i-save ang mga setting. I-reload ang page at subukan ulit.

options_blocking_help.message: Custom rules block during blacklist sessions. Ang whitelist is what stays reachable during whitelist sessions. Bundled categories block common time sinks.

options_bundled_categories_help.message: Ang bundled categories ay pre-built na groupings ng mga sikat na time-wasting sites.

options_schedule_help.message: Sessions start on angir own inside angse windows. Strictness set here applies for ang whole window.

options_rules_help.message: facebook.com covers that domain and every subdomain. news.ycombinator.com covers that subdomain and anything under it. /youtube\.com\/shorts/ matches ang full URL as a regular expression.

options_number_error_positive.message: Ang $LABEL$ ay dapat na positibong buong numero.

options_number_error_whole.message: $LABEL$ must be a whole number ng zero o greater.

LABEL.example: Minutes of site access per 30 minutes of focus

options_number_error_minute_range.message: $LABEL$ must be within ang supported minute range.

options_number_error_day_range.message: $LABEL$ must be within ang supported day range.

options_session_defaults_help.message: Mode and strictness are fixed when a session starts. Angse are ang values ang start form opens with.

options_strictness_flexible_label.message: Flexible: end ang session whenever you choose

options_strictness_friction_label.message: Friction: stopping early uses ang configured deliberation gate

options_strictness_hard_label.message: Mahirap: no early end, tempoary site pag-access saly

options_cycle_help.message: Defaults: 25 minute focus, 5 minute break, 15 minute long break every 4th cycle. Breaks on a schedule beat break-when-you-feel-like-it for mood and focus in study samples. Ang exact minutes are convention, not science.

options_cycle_default_label.message: Siklus pokus at pahsagas by default

options_gate_help.message: A 10 second wait with an explicit back-to-work button measurably reduces impulse visits (field study, PNAS 2023). Ang longer wait and ang typed sentence roughly double ang effect.

options_custom_delay_error.message: Cussam delay must be a positive whole number ng secsads.

options_gate_force_end_label.message: Paganahin "Ignore timeout and end anyway" button

options_credit_help.message: Site access credit accrues while you focus. Both access to all sites and a single-site unlock spend from ang same balance. Maaari kang step away at any time nang walang spending credit.

options_earn_rate_label.message: Minutes of site access per 30 minutos of focus

options_streak_help.message: Ang streak counts days that reach ang goal. One default session keeps ang chain alive, and a freeze token repairs a missed day.

options_host_kept_available_announcement.message: Ang site ay nanatiling available sa normal na oras.

options_all_sites_kept_available_announc.message: Ang lahat ng sites ay nanatiling available sa normal na oras.

options_category_uncheck_help.message: I-uncheck ang site upang manatiling available habang ang ibang bahagi ng category ay nablok.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.message: This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from this device. It does not clear a tumatakbo session, which keeps its intention and ang address of each tab it is blocking. Ending ang session clears ang intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, and ang cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.

This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from this device, plus local-only aggregate statistics. It does not clear a tumatakbo session, which keeps its intention and ang address of each tab it is blocking. Ending ang session clears ang intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, and ang cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.
